item.description: An Iron County woman was arrested this week after her daughter reported that she had left drug paraphernalia and controlled substances inside her vehicle.

item.title: Police search for suspect who fired gun during fight near 800 S 700 W in Salt Lake City
item.description: Salt Lake City Police Department responded to the area of 800 South and 700 West after shots fired and are now actively looking for a suspect who fled the scene.

item.title: 'Mother Nature doesn't mess around': Man speaks out after rescuing Brighton avalanche victim
item.description: A significant avalanche risk is expected to persist through the weekend. Yesterday in Brighton, we told you about the avalanche that tragically took the life of a young girl. Now, we’re learning about another close call on the same mountain, a man who was caught in an avalanche but rescued in time.

item.title: One killed after snowmobile accident in Wasatch County
item.description: One person is dead after a snowmobile accident in Wasatch County.

item.title: DHHS report flagged company's training procedure days before fatal carbon monoxide poisoning
item.description: A DHHS report revealed that they flagged employee training procedures for a local health services company, less than two weeks before three patients died in the care of one of their employees.
